title: Deck
description: A deck with its whole decklist: GET /decks/:id and GET /precon_decks/:id. Both have this shape, so the client loads a precon the same way as its own deck.

deck.description: A deck summary for a user deck, a precon deck summary for a precon.

cards.description: One entry per printing and board, commander first. The quantities add up to deck.card_count. A printing on two boards has the same card object in both.

board.description: Precons have no sideboard; mtgjson's mainBoard is lowercased.

tokens.description: Token definitions the deck can create. Precons list the tokens they ship with; user decks always have [].
